svg.title: Right knee: anterior layer (left) and deep cruciates, patella omitted (right)
svg.desc: Right knee from the front, patient right at the viewer's left, so the fibular head and lateral collateral ligament are at the left and the medial collateral ligament at the right. Left panel: patella with the patellar ligament. Right panel: patella omitted to show the deep layer: the ACL runs from the lateral femoral condyle to the anterior tibial intercondylar area; the PCL runs from the posterior tibial intercondylar area to the medial femoral condyle, passing behind the ACL.
